specification_purpose: Freeze the v6 candidate set, the v6 band and the v6 data boundary before any v6 evaluation runs. This artifact authorizes nothing.

code_identity.recompute_rule: the canonical source digest is recomputed from the *.py files under the hashed set root in ascending path order; the checkout-dependent ordered digest of compute_code_hash() is never used as an identity

band.recompute_rule: the band is re-derived from the raw market-cap snapshot bytes with the published rules: the qualifying names (strictly below the recomputed floor, not rule-excluded, not an asset of the v1, v2, v3, v4 or v5 universe) are taken in strictly descending market-capitalization order and the first band_width of them are the band; a recorded member list is never trusted
band.rule: The v6 batch is exactly top_n names taken in strictly descending market-capitalization order after the exclusion rules and the prior-universe identity rule have been applied. The band is a market-cap band: the validated subset is a consequence of the band, never its definition.
band.shortfall_rule: if fewer than band_width names qualify, the shortfall is recorded with the depth actually reached and the exclusion reasons; the band is not widened

candidate_set.rule: the candidate set is the validated subset of the frozen band; the band is the definition and the validated subset is its consequence

exclusions.name: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund
Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund
Janus Henderson Anemoy AAA CLO Fund
Spiko EU T-Bills Money Market Fund
Ondo Short-Term U.S. Government Bond Fund
Spiko US T-Bills Money Market Fund

floor.recompute_rule: the floor is the minimum market_cap_usd over the eligible_assets of research/universe_manifest_v5.json; the verifier recomputes it from that manifest and never trusts this recorded value

identity_rule.recompute_rule: the two counts are recomputed by the verifier from the five prior universe manifests; the base symbol and the pair spelling of the same Binance symbol are one marker, not two
identity_rule.rule: An asset is 'already in a prior universe' when its Binance symbol or its CoinGecko id already occurs in the eligible assets of the v1, v2, v3, v4 or v5 universe manifest.

data_boundary.access_counting: Every read of a candle inside a confirmatory window increments holdout_exposed_count in the v6 checkpoint and is recorded in the v6 holdout report.
data_boundary.confirmatory_window_membership_rule: a candle is inside a confirmatory window when its close falls strictly after that window's start and before its end, regardless of which asset the candle belongs to; a candle that closes exactly at a window's start is development data

confirmatory_window_membership_rule_owne.rule: the v6 specification was written with the corrected rule, so the v6 chain needs no membership amendment; the v5 amendment configs/research_v5_specification_amendment_1.json stays the owner of the v5 chain's own correction

data_boundary.development_cutoff_rule: the v6 development data ends at the last fully closed hour that closes at or before the cutoff: the last development candle is the one that closes exactly at the cutoff, and no candle that closes after the cutoff may be read (the inclusive convention of BRAIN-015)
data_boundary.development_data_rule: Candles that close at or before effective_data_boundary_utc are development data and may inform selection. No candle that closes after that instant may be read during selection.

development_window.recompute_rule: the development window is the closed hourly candle span that ends at the development cutoff: the last candle is the one that closes exactly at the cutoff and the first candle opens candle_count - 1 hours before it; both bounds are recomputed from the cutoff and the candle count

data_boundary.effective_data_boundary_rule: v6 uses the preregistered development cutoff (the v2 window start) as the binding boundary; the v6 confirmatory window opens after the freeze
data_boundary.min_confirmatory_window_rationale: 90 days of closed hourly candles; the v1 protocol used a 0.2 holdout fraction of a multi-year window, which is of the same order.
data_boundary.v6_confirmatory_window_start_rule: the first UTC hour boundary strictly after candidate_freeze_utc

confirmatory_window.evaluation_start_rule: the v6 evaluation may not start before the later of the four recorded gates and the v6 window's own earliest end
confirmatory_window.overlap_rule: the v6 confirmatory window opens inside the still-open v2, v3, v4 and v5 confirmatory windows, which is not a violation: the v6 evaluation may not start before the later of the four recorded gates and the v6 window's own earliest end, the two evaluations share no asset, and no confirmatory window is ever read for selection; windows are never read for selection

benchmark.boundary_rule: the benchmark dataset's last candle must close at or before the development cutoff; a dataset whose last candle closes after the cutoff is refused
benchmark.content_hash_digest_scope: the sha256 of the canonical hourly CSV serialization of the dataset file, recomputed from the file's bytes; the dataset is stored in that canonical form
benchmark.recompute_rule: the verifier recomputes the content hash, the row count and the first and last candle from the dataset file's own bytes; it never trusts a recorded digest

namespace.rule: every v6 artifact has its own name; no v6 artifact is written into a v1, v2, v3, v4 or v5 path, and no v1, v2, v3, v4 or v5 artifact is edited in place

supersedes.reason: The v5 candidate set is frozen for the v5 cycle. The v6 batch is a strictly additional universe below the v5 floor with separate namespaces.
supersedes.supersession_scope: Additive only. The v1, v2, v3, v4 and v5 artifacts are not replaced, rewritten or reinterpreted: they remain immutable historical evidence, and the v6 candidate set contains no asset of any of them.
supersedes.v5_candidate_freeze_hash_scope: the manifest_hash the v5 candidate freeze recomputes over its own body
supersedes.v5_candidate_freeze_sha256_scope: the sha256 of the v5 candidate freeze file's bytes on disk

producer.recompute_rule: the producer re-derives the band from the raw snapshot bytes and the validation outcomes from the validation evidence; it never copies a recorded member list

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the document body with the manifest_hash key removed; every other digest the document records is the digest of the file it names, recomputed from that file's bytes
